verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local inference runtime, so cold-start latency is a fair question for it. However, no vendor material claims a lightweight binary or fast startup time. The only on-topic hands-on report (ollama-comm-10) describes the opposite: it 'takes a long while before it starts giving a result.' Because there is no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed', and the model hot-swapping noted in the community is a different capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
